notes: Schedule publishing now validates and repairs employee identity fields, then reads every updated shift back before claiming success.
Employee My Schedule uses canonical roster/account/email identity matching so published shifts show for the selected month without exposing other employees shifts.
Schedule Builder shift chips are compact and keep supported time ranges on one horizontal line on mobile and desktop.
Protected founding System Administrator safeguards are reinforced in app-controlled Firestore user updates/deletes.
